note: SYNTHETIC. Hand-authored CALL-E responses so the whole workflow, including every failure state, can be demonstrated and tested without placing a call or spending CALL-E credits. The number is the reserved fictional +1 555-01xx range and belongs to nobody. Each fixture is pushed back through normalizeCall(), the same boundary a live call crosses, so the dry run and a real call render through one code path.
